title: KALAUPAPA DRINKING WATER SYSTEM REPAIRS COMPLETED; POWER OUTAGE DELAYS RETURN OF PATIENTS AND STAFF
summary: HONOLULU — The Hawaiʻi Department of Health (DOH) is continuing to coordinate with the National Park Service (NPS) and other partners to return patients and staff to Kalaupapa as soon as possible, following the successful repair of the settlement’s drinking water system.
